name: binwalk
notes: Installed with cargo install --locked binwalk@3.1.0 (crates.io crate; its Cargo.toml repository field is https://github.com/ReFirmLabs/binwalk). Binary is a Mach-O arm64 executable. test.sh builds a hand-made blob with gzip at 0x400, xz at 0x800 and a standalone zlib file, runs binwalk -e, and checks the signatures and extracted payloads. Passed on 2026-10-16. sha256 is null because the crate archive was not hashed; the git tag was not checked against the repo.
